name: token-build
summary: Turn the token source into the platform artefacts — CSS variables, Tailwind theme, iOS, Android — from one source, in one step.

when: tokens have to reach a platform
a build pipeline is being set up or changed
not: deciding what the tokens should be

steps: One source, many outputs. A platform that hand-maintains its own copy is a second source and will drift.
GENERATE, do not hand-write, and say so in the output file. A generated file someone edits is worse than no generation.
After generating, verify every var() the surfaces reference actually resolves — a renamed token leaves a dangling reference that renders as nothing and reports nothing.
Regenerating is part of the build. A JSON edit that does not reach the stylesheet is an edit that did not happen.
output: The generated artefacts plus the command that reproduces them.
done: every generated file says it is generated and names the command
the generator was actually run, not just described
